comment: Verified corrections for wiki pages whose infobox cannot be compiled correctly. Each applies only while the page's compiled ingredient text still equals inputText; a changed page drops the override into review.json instead of guessing.

recipes.title: Molten Glass
recipes.inputText: Sand x1, Lye 0.02 kg or Raw Glass
recipes.why: Two crafts share the page: Sand + Lye, or the separate 'Smelt Raw Glass'. Raw Glass is cooled Molten Glass, so as an ingredient it loops back on itself.

recipes.title: Tree
recipes.inputText: Soil x4, Tree Seed*, Water (1.0 L)
recipes.why: The seed is plain text, not a link, so it was dropped. The quality formula sits under 'Ways to Improve the Quality of Farmed Trees', softcapped by Farming.
